import os, json
P='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0d1-u1-ceiling/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u094/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(P, exist_ok=True)

def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find 5-cells
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==5]
    seen=set(); boxes=[]
    for c in cells:
        if c in seen: continue
        stack=[c]; comp=set()
        while stack:
            x=stack.pop()
            if x in seen: continue
            seen.add(x); comp.add(x)
            i,j=x
            for ni,nj in ((i+1,j),(i-1,j),(i,j+1),(i,j-1)):
                if 0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w and g[ni][nj]==5 and (ni,nj) not in seen:
                    stack.append((ni,nj))
        rows=[i for i,j in comp]; cols=[j for i,j in comp]
        boxes.append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in boxes:
        # fill interior zeros
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                if out[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=2
        # top row gap column and pair side
        top=[out[r0][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)]
        gap=[j for j,v in zip(range(c0,c1+1),top) if v!=5][0]
        # direction: toward contiguous 5-pair in top row
        left_pair = top[0]==5 and top[1]==5 if len(top)>1 else False
        right_pair = top[-1]==5 and top[-2]==5 if len(top)>1 else False
        br=r0-1
        if left_pair:
            for j in range(0,gap+1): out[br][j]=2
        else:
            for j in range(gap,w): out[br][j]=2
    return out

# demos

src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==5]
    seen=set(); boxes=[]
    for c in cells:
        if c in seen: continue
        stack=[c]; comp=set()
        while stack:
            x=stack.pop()
            if x in seen: continue
            seen.add(x); comp.add(x)
            i,j=x
            for ni,nj in ((i+1,j),(i-1,j),(i,j+1),(i,j-1)):
                if 0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w and g[ni][nj]==5 and (ni,nj) not in seen:
                    stack.append((ni,nj))
        rows=[i for i,j in comp]; cols=[j for i,j in comp]
        boxes.append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in boxes:
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                if out[i][j]==0: out[i][j]=2
        top=[out[r0][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)]
        gap=[j for j,v in zip(range(c0,c1+1),top) if v!=5][0]
        left_pair = len(top)>1 and top[0]==5 and top[1]==5
        right_pair = len(top)>1 and top[-1]==5 and top[-2]==5
        br=r0-1
        if left_pair:
            for j in range(0,gap+1): out[br][j]=2
        else:
            for j in range(gap,w): out[br][j]=2
    return out
'''
